name: Specialty coffee
about: Colombia is famous for its coffee, and Bogotá has many cafés that roast and sell beans from local farms.
tip: Choose beans with the farm origin and roast date printed on the bag.

name: Emerald and silver jewelry
where: Certified emerald shops on Avenida Jiménez
about: Colombia produces some of the world's finest emeralds, and Bogotá is the center of the country's emerald trade.
tip: Always ask for a certificate, and avoid buying from street sellers.
